_paper: Gan Z, Lokugamage MP, Hatit MZC, Loughrey D, Paunovska K, Sato M, Cristian A, Dahlman JE. 'Nanoparticles containing constrained phospholipids deliver mRNA to liver immune cells in vivo without targeting ligands.' Bioeng Transl Med 2020;5(3):e10161. PMID 33758781, PMCID PMC7974401, DOI 10.1002/btm2.10161.
_first_author_check: Europe PMC core record authorString = 'Gan Z, Lokugamage MP, Hatit MZC, Loughrey D, Paunovska K, Sato M, Cristian A, Dahlman JE'. FIRST AUTHOR IS GAN Z, NOT DAHLMAN (Dahlman is last/corresponding). The folder name dahlmanje_33758781 names the senior author. Experiment_ID would therefore be ZG_2020, not JD_2020. No ZG_2020 exists in data/data_vitro.csv or data/data_vivo.csv (checked 2026-11-10: 43 vitro + 20 vivo Experiment_IDs enumerated).
_endpoint: Functional mRNA delivery read out as Cre-mRNA-driven tdTomato recombination in Ai14 mice. Two distinct quantities are reported: (i) '% tdTom+ cells above background' by flow cytometry, for the 109-LNP POOL (Fig 3b) and for one individual LNP (Fig 3i); (ii) 'Normalized Delivery', a COMPOSITIONAL barcode-sequencing statistic from tdTomato+ FACS-sorted cells (Fig 3c, 3f, 3g).
_readout_requires_expression: YES. Barcodes are sequenced only out of tdTomato+ cells, and a cell is tdTomato+ only if Cre mRNA was translated into functional Cre protein that excised the Lox-Stop-Lox cassette. This is downstream of translation, so it clears the F-066 bar that a cargo-abundance-before-translation readout fails. The paper's own wording: 'quantify how >100 nanoparticles functionally deliver mRNA (i.e., mRNA translated into protein)'.

The article's only supplementary item is Appendix S1 (btm210161-sup-0001-AppendixS1.pdf / BTM2-5-e10161-s001.pdf), confirmed as the complete supplementary set by the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles ZIP manifest (19 entries, one PDF).
_tier_ladder.2_si_tables: NOT AVAILABLE. Appendix S1 is 33 pages: pp.1-10 Materials and Methods (a near-duplicate of the main-text Methods, plus the synthesis of 10 phospholipids with 1H/13C NMR and HRMS), pp.11-21 NMR spectra as page images, pp.22-32 HRMS spectra as page images, p.33 references. pdfplumber find_tables() returns 0 tables on every page; a re-read with horizontal_strategy='explicit' over page rects also returns 0. _tier_ladder.3_author_repo_or_deposit: NULL RESULT, EXPLICITLY. The paper's own Data Access section reads: 'The data, analyses, and scripts used to generate all figures in the paper are available upon request from J.E.D. or dahlmanlab.org.' No deposit of any kind. Searched the JATS full text (88,909 chars) and the SI text layer (25,290 chars) for GSE[0-9]+, SRP[0-9]+, PRJNA[0-9]+, SRX[0-9]+, SRR[0-9]+, the token SRA, 'accession', 'deposit', 'github', 'zenodo', 'dryad', 'figshare', 'osf.io': ZERO hits for every one of those patterns in BOTH documents. The only hits were 'upon request' (1 in each) and 'dahlmanlab' (1 in each). provenance/tools/find_repo.py was run twice, once with --author Dahlman and once with --author Gan (the true first author), with --doi 10.1002/btm2.10161 and --pmid 33758781: 0 code-search hits on the DOI, 0 on the PMID, 0 repo hits on title keywords under either author; 16 title-keyword repos were returned and all 16 were filtered out as unrelated.
_tier_ladder.4_pdfplumber_text_table: USED, and it is the tier that carries every structural number in this curation. The 10 phospholipid structures, their acyl chains and their HRMS calcd/found masses come from the native text layer of Appendix S1 pp.1-8 (identical to the JATS full text), with no pixel touched. Fig 2b's 4x4 molar-ratio table is the one exception: it is drawn inside a raster figure and was transcribed by eye (see 5_pixels).
_tier_ladder.5_pixels: USED ONLY FOR READING LABELS AND SIGNS, NEVER FOR A VALUE WE EMIT. Tiers 1-3 failed for the reasons stated above and tier 4 cannot reach a figure panel. The three article figures were obtained as JPEGs from the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles ZIP for PMC7974401 and measure 709 px on the long edge (Fig1 709x446, Fig2 709x484, Fig3 709x776). A nine-panel figure at 709 px total width yields roughly 180-230 px per panel, which is below any defensible bar-digitisation precision and there is no page rect, so native dpi is NOT DERIVABLE and axis.native_tol() would refuse it. We therefore ran NO digitiser: no bar top, no axis calibration, no heatmap read. What was taken from pixels is (a) the Fig 2b molar-ratio table numerals, which are printed digits in a table drawn inside the figure, checked by their own sum-to-100; (b) the Fig 2d/3f/3h category labels A-9...A-17-2Z; (c) the Fig 3b cell-type labels, counted; (d) the SIGN (above/below zero) of the ten Fig 3h enrichment bars, checked against the caption's printed count of five. No emitted row depends on any of these, because no row is emitted.

_why_no_values_are_emitted: BLOCKER 1 - ONE IONIZABLE LIPID. All 109 LNPs share a single ionizable lipid, cKK-E15 (main text: 'we used a lipid-PEG (C14PEG2000), cholesterol (cholesterol, 20alpha-hydroxycholesterol, beta-sitosterol), and ionizable lipid (cKK-E15) components that were previously characterized'; drawn once in Fig 2a). The varying factors are the constrained PHOSPHOLIPID (10 levels), the sterol (3 levels) and the molar ratio (4 levels). A corpus keyed on ionizable-lipid chemistry gains exactly one structure from this paper however many rows exist.

BLOCKER 2 - NO PER-LNP VALUE IS ATTRIBUTABLE. The design supports 109 LNPs x 16 cell types = 1,744 per-LNP normalized-delivery values and the authors computed them, but the paper publishes none of them against an identified LNP. Fig 3c plots ~109 UNLABELLED grey points on one axis; Fig 3f collapses to 10 phospholipid means (over 3 sterols x 4 ratios x 16 cell types); Fig 3g collapses to 3 sterol means; Fig 3h reports a derived enrichment statistic, not a delivery value. The 11 of 120 formulations dropped at QC are never identified, so the 109 members cannot even be enumerated. Attributed per-LNP values = 0.

NOT A BLOCKER - pooling. LR_2023 contributes 407 of the 1,803 in-vivo rows from a barcoded pool, and this paper's readout clears the F-066 translation bar (see _readout_requires_expression). Pooling is not why this paper yields zero.
